linkedin.text:
Water changes how a group behaves. Not the sea — flat, enclosed water. People sit longer, talk quieter, and stop checking the time.

This is from an Italian programme we produced, at a waterside viewpoint outside Rome.

For a senior group this register is often the right one and it is chronically under-sold, because it does not photograph as dramatically as a coastline. What it does deliver is conversation, which is usually the actual objective of a leadership offsite even when the brief does not say so.

The operational note: lakeside venues are small. Forty covers is a large restaurant here, boat capacity is fixed, and there is rarely a plan B within twenty minutes if weather closes the terrace. You plan the wet-weather version properly or you do not book the venue.

If the goal is conversation rather than spectacle in 2026, tell us and we will build for that.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure
